page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. This configuration results in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core, prioritizing processing power over memory capacity.

The instance does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration for public internet access.

With a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:1, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. It is suitable for tasks such as batch processing, distributed analytics nodes, web serving, and CPU-bound computational workloads where dedicated CPU allocation is critical but memory demands are minimal.
